text:
Conflict card for developer:

Input case: an archive on tape with few_copies = true and embargo = true.

Rule A - Replicate archives that have too few copies - applies and requires action replicate.

Rule B - Quarantine embargoed archives - applies and requires action quarantine.

The required actions replicate and quarantine are incompatible for this same input. Which rule wins?
cost_basis: all terminal provider usage, persisted from first request
